metrics.name: revenue_by_product_group_and_country
metrics.description: Delivered and shipped revenue (line_total, gross) per product group and country, per currency - currencies are never added together
metrics.sql: SELECT currency, country, product_group, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM data WHERE order_status IN ('Delivered', 'Shipped') GROUP BY currency, country, product_group ORDER BY currency, country, product_group

metrics.name: buyers_by_preferred_group
metrics.description: Distinct buyers per stated preference (Electrical / Produce / Both)
metrics.sql: SELECT pref_product_group, COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) AS buyers FROM data GROUP BY pref_product_group ORDER BY pref_product_group

metrics.name: stated_vs_actual_group
metrics.description: What buyers say they prefer against what they actually bought (order lines)
metrics.sql: SELECT pref_product_group AS stated, product_group AS bought, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM data GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

metrics.name: stated_vs_actual_channel
metrics.description: Preferred channel against the channel actually used (order lines)
metrics.sql: SELECT pref_channel AS stated, channel AS used, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM data GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

metrics.name: price_sensitivity_vs_discount
metrics.description: Average discount on the lines of buyers by price sensitivity
metrics.sql: SELECT pref_price_sensitivity, COUNT(*) AS lines, ROUND(AVG(discount_pct), 2) AS avg_discount_pct FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: top_categories_by_age_group
metrics.description: Order lines per age group and category
metrics.sql: SELECT age_group, category, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM data GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, lines DESC, 2

metrics.name: return_rate_by_group
metrics.description: Share of lines returned, per product group
metrics.sql: SELECT product_group, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE return_flag) AS returned FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: revenue_by_loyalty_tier
metrics.description: Delivered and shipped revenue (gross) by loyalty tier, per currency; buyers counted once
metrics.sql: SELECT currency, loyalty_tier, COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) AS buyers, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM data WHERE order_status IN ('Delivered', 'Shipped') GROUP BY currency, loyalty_tier ORDER BY currency, CASE loyalty_tier WHEN 'Platinum' THEN 1 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 2 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 3 WHEN 'Bronze' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

metrics.name: churn_risk_by_income_band
metrics.description: Average churn risk per income band, one value per buyer (not per order line)
metrics.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT buyer_id, ANY_VALUE(income_band) AS income_band, ANY_VALUE(churn_risk) AS churn_risk FROM data GROUP BY buyer_id) SELECT income_band, COUNT(*) AS buyers, ROUND(AVG(churn_risk), 3) AS avg_churn_risk FROM b GROUP BY income_band ORDER BY CASE income_band WHEN '<20k' THEN 1 WHEN '20-40k' THEN 2 WHEN '40-70k' THEN 3 WHEN '70-100k' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

metrics.name: lifetime_value_by_buyer_type
metrics.description: Average lifetime value per buyer type, one value per buyer
metrics.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT buyer_id, ANY_VALUE(buyer_type) AS buyer_type, ANY_VALUE(buyer_lifetime_value) AS ltv FROM data GROUP BY buyer_id) SELECT buyer_type, COUNT(*) AS buyers, ROUND(AVG(ltv), 2) AS avg_lifetime_value FROM b GROUP BY buyer_type ORDER BY avg_lifetime_value DESC

metrics.name: monthly_revenue
metrics.description: Delivered and shipped revenue (gross) per month and currency
metrics.sql: SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, currency, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM data WHERE order_status IN ('Delivered', 'Shipped') GROUP BY 1, currency ORDER BY 1, currency

metrics.name: top_products_by_revenue
metrics.description: The 5 products with the highest delivered and shipped revenue in each currency (compare within one currency only)
metrics.sql: SELECT currency, product_name, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(line_total) AS revenue FROM data WHERE order_status IN ('Delivered', 'Shipped') GROUP BY currency, product_name QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY SUM(line_total) DESC, product_name) <= 5 ORDER BY currency, revenue DESC, product_name

metrics.name: delivery_days_by_shipping_method
metrics.description: Average delivery days of delivered orders by shipping method
metrics.sql: SELECT shipping_method, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(AVG(delivery_days), 2) AS avg_days FROM data WHERE order_status = 'Delivered' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: review_score_by_product_group
metrics.description: Average review score and how many lines have one, per product group
metrics.sql: SELECT product_group, COUNT(review_score) AS reviews, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: returns_by_category
metrics.description: Return rate per category
metrics.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE return_flag) AS returned, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE return_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS returned_pct FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY returned_pct DESC, category

metrics.name: organic_stated_vs_bought
metrics.description: Buyers' stated organic preference against the produce they bought (organic or not), order lines
metrics.sql: SELECT pref_organic AS prefers_organic, is_organic AS bought_organic, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM data WHERE product_group = 'Produce' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

metrics.name: check_line_total_formula
metrics.description: Lines where line_total differs from quantity x price x (1-discount) x (1+tax) rounded to cents (expect 0)
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines_off FROM data WHERE ABS(line_total - ROUND(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct / 100.0) * (1 + tax_rate_pct / 100.0), 2)) > 0.011

metrics.name: check_order_before_signup
metrics.description: Lines dated before the buyer signed up (should be 0)
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines_before_signup, COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) AS buyers FROM data WHERE order_date < signup_date

metrics.name: check_cancelled_with_review
metrics.description: Cancelled orders that still carry a review score (should be 0)
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_with_review FROM data WHERE order_status = 'Cancelled' AND review_score IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: check_returned_flag_agrees
metrics.description: Returned status and return_flag disagree (expect 0)
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS disagree FROM data WHERE (order_status = 'Returned') <> return_flag
